title: When the Tide Burns
author: Gideon Delacroix
blurb: Jonah Reyes, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
